description: This PHP source file defines the ResetCodeController class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles password reset code validation, manages CSRF tokens, and prepares the Vue.js components for password reset or error display based on URL validation.

classes.name: ResetCodeController
classes.description: Controller managing password reset code validation and rendering password reset or error components.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns an instance of ResetPasswordService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component based on reset code validation, assigning either a password reset component with user info and CSRF token or an error component.
